example_context: Actual scanner output from a deliberately writable local test fixture named sudoers, not a claim about active host sudoers configuration. This is an extracted example, not a complete report.

finding.title: Sudoers configuration has unsafe write metadata
finding.description: A sudoers configuration path has permissive write metadata. Sudo may reject insecure modes; LASA does not claim the file will be accepted.
